data.name: Harinarayan
data.gender_notes: Harinarayan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Harinarayan is a compound name derived from Hari and Narayan. Hari is a name for Lord Vishnu, and Narayan is a name for Lord Vishnu as the supreme cosmic ruler. The name signifies the divine presence and protection of Lord Vishnu. The name Harinarayan carries the meaning “Hari (God Vishnu) + Narayan (God Vishnu's Name)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harinarayan usually hope their child will grow to embody hari (god vishnu) + narayan (god vishnu's name) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies devotion to Lord Vishnu and his divine protection.
data.etymology: Harinarayan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Hari (God Vishnu) + Narayan (God Vishnu's Name).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harinarayan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
